Name: Better Beach Farms
Author: aaphra
Description:
[center][color=#4e6f8d][size=6][u][b]Better Beach Farms[/b][/u][/size][/color][size=4][/size][/center][size=4]

Removes the wooden plank debris found at the bottoms of the Beach Farm and Ginger Island farms to allow space for building or farming/production or placing items. Also permits sprinklers to be placed on sand for easy farm management.[/size][size=5][color=#608ea6][b][u]

[/u][/b][/color][/size][center][size=5][color=#608ea6][b][u]DETAILS[/u][/b][/color][/size][/center]
Replaces the debris tiles on the southern edge of the maps. The new tiles are fully open for pathing, decorating, and farming.
One version (recommended) affects both the Beach Farm and Ginger Island Farm. Second version only affects the Beach Farm and leaves Ginger Island unchanged.
[b][color=#980000]USE ONLY ONE VERSION AT A TIME[/color][/b]

[b]Requirements:
-[/b]SMAPI (4.1.10+)
-Content Patcher (2.5.0+)
[b]
Compatibility:
[/b]-Should work on existing saves. Be sure to backup your save file just in case!
-Will not be compatible with mods that alter the same tiles of the Beach Farm or Ginger Island map. There may be conflict with mods that alter the spring_island_tilesheet1 and island_tilesheet1 files.
-Only use one version of this mod at time

[b]Installation: [/b]Unzip and place into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.


Credit to ConcernedApe for the map assets.
[b][u]                                                                                                                                                                          [/u][/b][b]
